'''Rover droids''' were a model of [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]]. Built on the same platform as the [[MSE-6 series repair droid/Legends|MSE-6-series repair droid]], the droids were armed with a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]]. Rover droids were employed extensively by the [[ComNet Corporation]] at the [[Ord Mynock Freeport]].<ref name="Game" />
